reviewer_scope: Authored the head and expression numeric compiler/calibration proofs. Independently reviewed the literal source theorem, frozen contracts, head/source and expression semantic arguments, closed statement gates, and collected native evidence.
source_correspondence_review: PolynomialHeadCoverage covers every actual nonzero limit below omega^omega. ValidHead keeps normality and both source ordinal hypotheses. Positive finite principal degrees are proved from the polynomial bound and are not assumed for arbitrary exponents.

The literal alphabet is signed shifts, Phi, V_j, signed scheduled X^d_{c,j}, and scheduled E^d_c. LetterDomain retains the source nonnegative-shift, positive-depth, and budget conditions. The stronger companion startup domain occurs only inside the proof that emitted calls have the original domains.

Call compilation preserves both the endpoint and complete replacement count. Degree one emits Phi and twice-count 2; degree two emits the exact negative ceiling shift and doubled counter correction; higher degrees keep source X and E symbols. Substitution composes unary words and never applies a source function to a sum.

HeadCodeCalibration identifies the actual numeric word and additive source norm. HeadSourceProof transports the accepted principal-word run and every dynamically reached genuine domain to positive finite degrees, then applies the exact shift n+N(lambda). HeadGraphExact therefore holds for all natural n, including zero.

The explicit cutoff zero and empty finite-exception list are justified by the all-natural graph/domain theorem. No finite input is discarded. HeadEquationExact is the literal integer word-linear equation 2*y-P(n)=0, with exact actual-collapse meaning and unique natural output.
The degree bound is computed from each head code or finite head family. No uniform finite bound across all possible source heads is imposed.

The expression grammar covers natural constants, shared original variables, addition, fixed natural multiples, and arbitrary finite nesting of fixed valid polynomial heads. Every emitted collapse row uses its actual child node. Repeated original names remain the same free names.

Allocation and support theorems identify every fresh node and exclude all unbound auxiliary names. Semantic realization preserves every original value; soundness and allocated-node uniqueness identify the literal row system with the source expression. Every row has its source domain on every natural valuation.

The emitted graph quantifies exactly the finite list of fresh natural node names. A function-valued valuation occurs only in a framing proof lemma. CorrelatedExistentialGraph remains exact even when the requested result symbol is an input name; TotalFunctionalGraph uses the appropriate fresh-result condition.

HeadPrograms and ActualNumericProgram prove primitive recursiveness of the actual syntax constructors, radix-five parser, row machine, degree, allocation, and complete package. InstructionCodeCalibration, RowMachineCalibration, and LiteralGraphCompiler identify the computed artifact exactly with the semantic rows and symbolic result link.
scope_exclusions: No promotion of any source statement other than paper08 thm:graphs.
No claim of closed existential word-arithmetic decidability, general guard or ranked-row transformations, arbitrary first-order BASE arithmetic, or the internal-level-two comparison consumer.
No full-root, cumulative-union, or remote-CI build claim.
